name: Burger drive-through
description: Generic burger drive-through restaurant, 20 x 14 m building with a drive-through lane down the east side (25 x 18 m overall): red and yellow fascia bands as blank sign panels, a glazed front with fixed booths, a steel entrance canopy, rooftop air-conditioning units and the kitchen extract fan. Enterable: a dining room with fixed booths facing a service counter with three registers and menu panels in a hatch to the kitchen, a commercial kitchen with fryer bank, griddle and range under a stainless extraction hood ducted up through the roof, holding cabinets, a prep table and the drive-through window, a walk-in cooler annex, and restrooms with cubicles.
